notes.title: Tap and Play: Barbie in Action - Free Update Now Live!🍑💥
notes.content:
[h1]Hey there, fabulous players! 💖[/h1]

Get ready to step into a whole new world of fun, sass, and just the right amount of tap-tastic action, because our latest free update, "Barbie in Action: Tap and Play," is here to spank up your gameplay! (pun intended, of course)

We’ve always known that our game wasn’t just about living that fabulous plastic life—it’s about exploring the endless possibilities of play. And what better way to do that than by adding a playful spanking feature that’s guaranteed to bring out the cheeky side of everyone?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283213/f1697bd50163869a666e82fd23499c4c63b428c8.gif[/img]
[h2]
💥 What’s New?[/h2]
    [list]
[*] Playful Spanking Mode: Lighthearted, cheeky fun at your fingertips (or controllers) [b]AVAILABLE FOR PC AND VR MODE[/b].
[*] Available Everywhere: Every scene, every character.
[*] New dedicated VO: Feel the tap, live the drama.
[/list]
[h3]💋 Stay fabulous, keep tapping, and don’t forget to share your thoughts with us, we're always looking for ways to improve our toys!
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283213/f948a935ad5eac46143de7ec606ea8c9daa5998c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 🎉 Announcement: Costume Fighter is Live – Get Ready for the ultimate showdown!
notes.content:
Get ready to brawl in this side-splitting showdown where fighters don't just bring their fists to the fight, but their wackiest costumes and zaniest moves.

'Costume Fighter' is not your typical fighting game – it's the hottest extravaganza that will keep you entertained and in stitches for hours on end. Get ready to embrace the chaos, battle in style, and become the champion of getting laid. Are you ready to dress for success and fight for orgasms?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283213/22b799e903f50700b38d1e6ede1470594899fae0.jpg[/img]

[b]
Complex movesets[/b]
Explore more than 12 different poses in all the scenes.

[b]1v1 is only the beginning[/b]
Threesome mode is availible in all our scenes. We all now 1v1 works, but get the "fight" to another level adding one more character to the action.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283213/5e6d7436076550db33265e47c373884170f48575.gif[/img]
[b]Fully Voice Acted Action[/b]
We let our VAs know what they were getting into ahead of time so thankfully nobody passed out when they received their scripts. The result of their hard work should get you even harder!

[b]FINISH HER![/b]
Inlcuding 4 different moneyshot finisher moves to end with style!
